name: 710 Labs Joint | Rainbow Belts
description:
There’s a reason our flower is renowned industry-wide - we never blind source. we meticulously grow our ladies in-house with wholly organic inputs, dry and cure it based on density, and trim it by hand to bring you the most opulent, flavor-dense nugs in the market.

Genetics: Z x Moonbow

Tasting Notes: Lemon-lime La Croix with a sweet floral exhale.
